findings.title: Preserve the original-error-without-stack test case
findings.why_it_matters: The test now supplies an Error with a stack, so it exercises the existing stack-copy branch instead of checking stack generation when an original error has no stack. A regression that leaves such GraphQL errors without a stack can therefore pass the suite.
evidence: src/error/GraphQLError.js:195-202 copies originalError.stack when present and generates a stack only in the alternative branch.
The old test passed a plain object without stack; on Node the new Error has a stack and the assertion that e.stack is a string passes via the copy branch.
provenance: 7e39a122 Ivan Goncharov 2018-11-21 - Enable Flow typings on errors tests + Fix typing for Error constructor
findings.suggested_fix: Construct an Error whose stack is explicitly removed or set to undefined before passing it to GraphQLError, and retain the assertion that the resulting stack is a string.
